links.outcome: AI-ECG performance across clinical subgroups (CKD, acute cardiac conditions)
links.effect: Subgroup analysis reported robust performance in patients with chronic kidney disease and acute cardiac conditions; no subgroup numbers given, and no demographic subgroups analyzed.
links.quote: Subgroup analysis showed robust performance in patients with chronic kidney disease and acute cardiac conditions.

screen.reason: Prospective observational study evaluating the clinical performance and workflow impact (time-to-therapy) of an AI-powered ECG diagnostic and alerting tool in emergency and cardiology settings, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice variation.
